The late-delivery rate decreased significantly from 6.56% to 1.16%, contrary to the initial question. This suggests a substantial improvement in delivery performance, but the question about an increase may have been based on a misunderstanding or misinterpretation of the data.

## Findings
- Late-delivery rate %: 6.56% (2018-05) → 1.16% (2018-06)
- Orders: 6873 (2018-05) → 6167 (2018-06)
- Cancellation rate %: 0.58% (2018-05) → 0.36% (2018-06)
- Average delivery time (days): 11.3 (2018-05) → 9.2 (2018-06)
- Average promised delivery window (days): 23.5 (2018-05) → 28.4 (2018-06)

## Investigate first
- Analyze the reasons behind the significant drop in the late-delivery rate and how it correlates with the reduction in orders and average delivery time.
- Investigate the change in the average promised delivery window to understand if it reflects improved delivery performance or a shift in customer expectations.
